title: TranscriptAnalysisResponse
description: JSON Schema passed to Claude output_config.format.schema. Defines the exact structure the AI must return. Application validates against the Zod counterpart in src/integrations/claude/prompt.ts.

title.description: Descriptive meeting title derived from transcript content and the determined score band (e.g. 'HOT: Platform Demo — Budget Approved, POC Agreed')

narrative.description: Single paragraph summarizing the meeting outcome. Must reference the score band and explain why that band was assigned based on detected signals.

whatWeHeard.description: Key points, concerns, or statements heard from the prospect side during the meeting.

whatWasCovered.description: Distinct topics discussed during the meeting as concise summary points.

whatWasDecided.description: Decisions made or agreed upon during the meeting.

owner.description: Name or role of the person responsible.

dueDate.description: Due date as stated in the transcript (e.g. 'end of week', '2026-08-01'). Omit if not mentioned.

name.description: Full name of the attendee as mentioned in the transcript.

side.description: 'kaffeax' for internal team members; 'prospect' for client-side participants.

commitments.description: Commitments made by each side during the meeting. Each commitment is attributed to either the internal team (kaffeax) or the prospect.

openQuestions.description: Questions or topics raised during the meeting that were not resolved or answered by the end of the meeting.

bandSuggestion.description: The AI's assessment of the lead score band. Application code verifies this against deterministic rules and overrides if they diverge (FR-025).

signalId.description: The signalId from the rubric context block injected into the prompt. Must exactly match one of the provided signal IDs.

label.description: The signal label from the rubric context block.

evidence.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim excerpt from the transcript that demonstrates this signal is present. Must be traceable to actual transcript content.

detectedSignals.description: Signals from the rubric that are present in this transcript. Only include signals that are clearly evidenced. Do not hallucinate evidence.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of the band assignment. Must reference the detected signals and the applicable banding rule (e.g. 'Scored HOT because a hot-weight signal was detected and a concrete next step was agreed').

hasAgreedNextStep.description: Whether a concrete next step was agreed during the meeting (e.g. a follow-up call, a POC, a proposal review). Required for the HOT band determination rule.

email.description: Prospect email address if found in the transcript. Omit if no email address was mentioned.

confidence.description: 'high' = email was stated explicitly and clearly; 'medium' = inferred or partially stated; 'low' = not found or very uncertain.
